rows: Record first half 2021: total revenue +98% to $115M, North America +130% to $92.6M, international +25% to $22.5M.
Management positioned Celsius as 'ENERGY 2.0' - a cross between conventional, healthy and functional energy - disrupting the category.
Three category tailwinds cited: better-for-you ingredients, functional benefits, and growth of the fitness channel.
Nielsen data shows Celsius outpacing the category by over 10%, with a 1.6% share of the ~$20B US energy drink market (up from 0.2 in 2018).
National DSD network reached 189 distributors, ~95% population coverage, ~87% of US counties; approximately full US coverage expected by year-end.
Target and Walmart over 95% converted to DSD; Murphy Oil win added 15,000 stores with six facings.
Principal headwind: COVID-driven supply chain constraints on cans and raw materials pressuring margins; strategic inventory build elevated inventory days to ~156-160 vs normalized ~90-100.
GAAP gross margin 43.4% (~51-52% ex-freight); CFO booked 'a couple of charges' in Q2 to ensure adequate reserves.
Debt-free balance sheet bolstered by the June capital raise (~$67-68M), to be reinvested into high-ROI growth activities.
International expansion: Europe (Sweden, Finland, Norway) growing 22-25%; UK and Germany to be serviced via Amazon by end of Q3, Amazon leveraged as the European online provider.
Asia: China licensing royalty agreement; expanded into Hong Kong, Malaysia, South Korea, Australia with more on the target list.
Building adjacent categories - Celsius BCAA recovery line, Celsius HEAT performance line, and the FAST protein-snack portfolio.
50/50 male-female consumer base; 19% of sales from consumers new to the category.
Tone confident and forward-looking; meeting proceeded directly to voting results with no shareholder questions.

No analyst or shareholder Q&A occurred. CEO John Fieldly opened the floor for questions from the in-person audience and online chat, polled twice with no response, and closed the Q&A. This was an Annual Shareholder Meeting; no analysts participated.
